rules.COMMERCIAL_HIGH: Recognized functional wear/maintenance component (spark plug, air/fuel/oil filter, starter, clutch, sprocket, guide bar, chain, oil pump, AV buffer, gaskets, fuel hose, primer, mowing head)
rules.COMMERCIAL_MEDIUM: Drive gears, high-breadth components (>= 5 models or >= 10 fitments)
rules.COMMERCIAL_LOW: Generic fasteners, hardware, low-breadth components (2-4 models)
